sections: Supply your schema in the API call
findings: Documented Structured Outputs preserve the schema key order.
The first use of a schema can add schema-processing latency; repeated requests with that schema do not have that additional setup latency.
documentation.scope: Current public API documentation. This is not a captured wire trace or proof of the exact implementation used by pinned Codex 0.160.1.

sourceObservations: The automatic-answer schema defines intent before text.
It is the same two-field schema for every automatic question and refinement.
interpretation: Text-first gating is a behavior the local decoder permits, but it should not be treated as an observed or leading explanation for these tails. Under the documented schema-order contract and this schema, intent precedes text. Actual raw chunks are absent, so pinned runtime field order and decoder cost remain unmeasured. Likewise, a repeated unchanged schema does not establish recurring setup delay.
